findings.evidence: grep: only `comp_equiv`/`equiv_comp` call sites are SmallPerturbation.lean:105,192; Mathlib f4fd7f7e Fredholm/Basic.lean:441-448 states both directions under `[CompleteSpace 𝕜]` plus TVS instances that every normed space has.
findings.fix: Delete both lemmas and the private helper `closedComplemented_map_continuousLinearEquiv` (Basic.lean:136, used only at line 218), and rewrite SmallPerturbation.lean:105 and :192 with `ContinuousLinearMap.isFredholm_comp_equiv.mpr` / `isFredholm_equiv_comp.mpr`. The index lemmas `index_comp_equiv`/`index_equiv_comp` and the remaining private helpers stay, Mathlib having no index. If the incomplete-scalar-field version is judged worth keeping anyway, state it at Mathlib's level for these constructions — TVS, as `ContinuousLinearEquiv.isFredholm` (Fredholm/Basic.lean:379) is — since the proof uses no norm: `ContinuousLinearEquiv.isClosed_image` (Topology/Algebra/Module/Equiv.lean:236), `Homeomorph` strictness, and algebraic ker/range lemmas.
findings.issue: `ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.equiv_comp` (line 180) and `.comp_equiv` (line 203) are kept as one-way, normed-space restatements of Mathlib's `ContinuousLinearMap.isFredholm_equiv_comp` / `isFredholm_comp_equiv` (mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Fredholm/Basic.lean:441,446, both `↔`, `@[simp]`). Their sole claimed advantage is dropping `CompleteSpace 𝕜`, but both in-repo uses (SmallPerturbation.lean:105, 192) sit in a section with `[CompleteSpace 𝕜]` (see `omit [CompleteSpace 𝕜] in` at SmallPerturbation.lean:149), and the HeegaardFloer roadmap works over ℝ/ℂ — the extra generality has no user. The repo thus carries a weaker shadow of the canonical API.

findings.evidence: Criteria.lean:112 vs FiniteRank.lean:44-49; the other producers now yield `HasFiniteRange` directly (Restriction.lean:102-103, CompactPerturbation.lean:92-95).
findings.fix: Restate `isFredholm_ker_subtypeL` with `(hT : LinearMap.HasFiniteRange (T : E →ₗ[K] F))`, deriving the `FiniteDimensional` instance internally, and drop `hKfd` at FiniteRank.lean:46-49.
findings.issue: `isFredholm_ker_subtypeL` still takes `FiniteDimensional K (LinearMap.range T)` while the rest of the finite-rank API now speaks `LinearMap.HasFiniteRange`; its only caller has to convert back (FiniteRank.lean:46-47, `hKfd`), reinstating by hand the conversion the PR removed at the other three sites.

summary: The PR deletes five superseded lemmas but keeps `IsFredholm.comp_equiv`/`equiv_comp` as one-way, normed-only duplicates of Mathlib's `↔` lemmas, generalized only in a `CompleteSpace 𝕜` direction no call site or roadmap target uses; and `isFredholm_ker_subtypeL` is left on the `FiniteDimensional`-range spelling, reintroducing the conversion the PR set out to remove.
